name: Philia Elpis
source:
Philia controlled by the Dynamis-system.

After resonating with another Wail-of-Uroboros Philias original ability as DeaMachina that had fallen asleep when she had turned to human starts awaking. If Philia comes to contact with beings possessing wrong dragon factors Dynamis assumes controll regardless of Philias will and tries to destroy the factor.

Has in possession the anti-dragon weapon system Gears of Dragoon.
